acceptance: Strict Lean validity alone is FORMALLY_VERIFIED_PENDING_AI_REVIEW, never AI_SCREENED_FORMALLY_VERIFIED or human-approved

lean.verification_policy: src/verify.py exact-type harness, no proof escapes/new axioms; generated imports/commands additionally prohibited

model_choice: Cached coding-specialized Qwen2.5-Coder7B, selected before V2 responses to favor code syntax; no same-run model selection
parser_normalization: Outer whitespace and whole/field Markdown fences only; CRLF line endings normalized by splitlines/join to LF; NFC required, never Unicode rewritten; markers reserved on own lines; exact raw UTF8 bytes retained
stopping: Ten charged intents maximum; persisted 1800 second generation watchdog; stop on unavailable generation, no retries or substitution; formal checks deterministic, consumed incomplete checks remain unknown
